title: Bernstein-type theorem for stationary hypersurfaces of the Euler-Dierkes-Huisken functional
summary: We say that a hypersurface $Σ\subset\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ is $α$-stationary if it is a critical point of the Euler-Dierkes-Huisken functional $\mathcal{E}_α(Σ)=\int_Σ|X|^α\, d\mathcal{H}^n$, introduced by Dierkes and Huisken in \cite{[DH-24]}. In this paper, we prove that every smooth, complete, connected, embedded $α$-stationary hypersurface in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ passing through the origin with $α>0$ is a linear hyperplane.
